name: Liftoff
oneLiner: Grounded launch kits from your repository, reviewed locally
audience: Developers and coding agents preparing repository-backed launches
problem: Turning repository facts into launch assets while retaining sources and human review
proofPoints: Capture terminal commands as real demo footage

features.name: Repository scan
features.description: Read local README, package metadata and Git history

features.name: Terminal capture
features.description: Execute local commands and capture their actual output as PNG and GIF

features.name: Demo rendering
features.description: Render captured media with captions using ffmpeg or optional Remotion

features.name: Local review
features.description: Build a local approval page for launch posts and media

claims.text: Capture terminal commands as real demo footage
Plan profile-appropriate channels and local posting times
Export a sourced Launch Brief as local HTML
Prepare grounded writing briefs and check local drafts
Require approval matching the exact post and media hash
Prepare a local launch-day warroom without sending replies
